summary: To install all available updates on a schedule (for example lab systems), run a weekly job template whose playbook uses ansible.builtin.dnf with name '*' and state latest, with become: true.
questions: How do I update all packages with Ansible?
Playbook to install all RPM updates weekly

answer_card.title: Install all RPM updates
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Install all available RPM updates
  hosts: target_hosts
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Install latest RPMs
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name: '*'
        state: latest
```
Use it in a job template on a weekly schedule, for example for lab or non-production servers.
